versions.changelog:
Changelog for complicheck-skill v0.1.8

- Expanded payment error response documentation in SKILL.md to include detailed cases: replay attack, insufficient payment, and on-chain transaction failure.
- Added guidance for agents on how to handle the new `details` field in 402 Payment Required error responses.
- No code or interface changes detected; documentation update only.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md to clarify ingredient indexing, "not_found" handling, and how to query category terms.
- Improved authentication instructions to list allowed HTTP headers.
- Updated request and response examples for accuracy and coverage.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- Updated SKILL.md: protocol version in the version field changed from 1.0.0 to 0.1.3.
- Updated authentication options in the API spec to include Authorization: Bearer header.
- No changes to core functionality; only documentation and metadata changes.

Version 0.1.5 — No file changes detected.

- No updates or modifications introduced in this release.
- All features and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

Version 0.1.4

- No file changes detected in this version.
- No updates or new features introduced.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated price_per_check to "0.10 USDC" (was "0.05 SOL").
- Clarified authentication: x402 transaction signature can be provided via X-Payment-Hash header or payment_hash in the request body.
- Minor formatting improvements in request specification.

- Removed files: llms.txt and skill-card.md.
- Minor text simplifications in the skill description.
- Clarified authentication instructions in the request specification.
- No changes made to endpoint, functionality, or response format.

- Removed all agent configuration and documentation files.
- Updated SKILL.md to limit compliance checks to EU CosIng only; removed support and references to US FDA and China NMPA.
- Streamlined API request and response examples to include only EU market details.
- Updated metadata tags and removed LLM/hallucination language.
- Cleaned up documentation for clarity and focus on EU compliance.
